title: Air Mover Placement Count Covered by Dwelling Coverage (Water Damage Mitigation)
content:
Under this Water Damage Mitigation coverage standard, air movers are covered up to the IICRC placement count across the job's air mover lines.

## Standard
On a Class 3 job the placement count is one for every 60 square feet of the affected floor area, plus one for every 14 linear feet of the baseboard run on the job's baseboard removal lines, plus one for every 125 square feet of ceiling taken as the affected floor area, each term rounded up on its own; on a Class 2 job it is the floor term plus the wall term, each rounded up on its own. The covered air mover unit-days are the placement count multiplied by the number of air mover lines, and the total unit-days on those lines above the covered unit-days, priced at the tier's air mover daily rate, are a non-covered amount. On any other job every billed air mover unit-day is covered.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: affected floor area 480 square feet, baseboard run 60 linear feet, 6 air mover lines carrying 90 unit-days in total, assumed air mover rate $30.00)
- Floor term: 480 divided by 60, that is 8. Wall term: 60 divided by 14 is 4.29, rounded up to 5. Ceiling term: 480 divided by 125 is 3.84, rounded up to 4.
- Class 2: placement count 13; covered unit-days 13 times 6, that is 78; 12 unit-days above them, priced at $30.00, give $360.00 non-covered.
- Class 3: placement count 17; covered unit-days 102; the 90 billed unit-days are all covered.
- Class 1 or Class 4: every billed air mover unit-day is covered.
